The '''V-4 series''' was a line of ski [[speeder]]s produced by the [[Verpine]] vehicle manufacturer [[Roche Machines]] in response to a fad for [[asteroid slalom]] during the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. They had ventral mono-skis to keep them anchored and boom-mounted [[holocamera]]s to record maneuvers made by the [[pilot]].<ref name="TLJICS" />

Production of the line ceased and the remaining units were sold at a reduced price after the [[asteroid slalom]] craze ended following the live broadcast of several slalom racers and their vehicles being devoured at the [[Orleon Belt Grand Slalom Finals]]. Models in the series included the [[V-4X-D ski speeder]], which would be used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Resistance]].<ref name="TLJICS" />
